# Filter for rows where Team contains "Cowboys" (case-insensitive) and Season is in the 1970s (1970-1979)
cowboys_1970s = df[df['Team'].str.contains('Cowboys', case=False, na=False) & (df['Season'] >= 1970) & (df['Season'] <= 1979)]
# Count the number of unique seasons (in case of duplicates, though there shouldn't be)
answer = cowboys_1970s['Season'].nunique()
